Dear Ms. Grondinelli,

I am writing to apply for the Events Intern position at Eurelectric, as advertised on EuroBrussels. With a background in digital marketing, web development, and content management, I am confident in my ability to support the planning and execution of your events.

In my current roles, I have gained hands-on experience in managing websites, creating and scheduling content, and using digital tools to streamline processes. I have built and maintained event-related web pages, prepared mailers, and ensured consistent branding across platforms. My technical skills in WordPress, HTML/CSS, and automation allow me to quickly adapt to event apps and mini-sites. I am fluent in English, with native Turkish and basic Dutch, and I thrive in collaborative, international environments.

I am eager to contribute to Eurelectric's mission and would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills align with your team's needs.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Ms. Grondinelli,

I am writing to express my interest in the Events Intern position at Eurelectric, as advertised on EuroBrussels. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, web development, and content management, I am eager to contribute to the success of your events and support Eurelectric's mission in the electricity industry.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I have developed skills that directly align with the responsibilities of this internship. I have built and managed websites using WordPress and Elementor, ensuring they are user-friendly and visually appealing. I have created and scheduled content for various platforms, including mailers and web pages, and have experience in managing registration flows and distributing materials. My technical background allows me to quickly learn and adapt to new event platforms and mini-sites, ensuring accurate and timely updates to programme details, speaker information, and timings.

Moreover, I have a proven track record of working in structured, detail-oriented environments. For instance, I built a multi-page website for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data and running technical audits to improve search visibility. This required a methodical approach and a keen eye for detail—skills that are essential for coordinating event logistics. I am also comfortable using AI tools and automation to streamline repetitive tasks, which can enhance efficiency in event preparation.

I am fluent in English and possess strong written and oral communication skills, which I have honed through writing SEO content, managing client communications, and collaborating with international teams. My native Turkish and basic Dutch add to my ability to connect with diverse stakeholders. I am diplomatic and enjoy working with people, as demonstrated by my experience in client-facing roles and team projects.

I am particularly drawn to Eurelectric's role as the sector association for the electricity industry, and I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to events that bring together key players in the energy sector. I am confident that my blend of digital skills, structured mindset, and interpersonal abilities make me a strong candidate for this internship.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
